posts.title: A second folder-gluer cuts folding carton lead times to ten days
posts.excerpt: The new line glues crash-lock bottoms at 300 metres a minute and runs from November.
posts.content:
Our second folder-gluer arrived in September and runs its first production orders from 3 November. It glues straight-line and crash-lock bottom cartons at up to 300 metres a minute.

With two lines, standard folding carton runs drop from fourteen to ten working days, and short runs from 1,000 pieces fit between larger orders.

posts.title: New white E-flute with 60% recycled content now in stock
posts.excerpt: A clean white face for mailer boxes, with a recycled liner inside.
posts.content:
Our new white E-flute board pairs a bright white outer liner with a recycled kraft inner liner and fluting. It prints cleanly in four colours and costs the same as our previous white grade.

Plain samples in any mailer size ship within three working days.

posts.title: Drop testing every new carton size before the first run
posts.excerpt: Each new size now ships with an ISTA 1A report from our own lab.
posts.content:
From October every new shipping carton or mailer size is drop tested to ISTA 1A with the packed product before the first production run.

The report lists every drop, the damage found and the board we recommend, and it is sent with the printed proof.
